name: Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering
aliases: Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering — Adaptive Frequency Net (AFNet)
Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering — Adaptive Frequency Net (AFNet) based rendering, FreqPCR
definition: A point cloud rendering pipeline that uses an Adaptive Frequency Net (AFNet) to modulate implicit radiance signals with local texture frequency encoding, enabling high-fidelity local detail reconstruction, real-time rendering, and user-friendly editing.
summary: Frequency-Modulated Point Cloud Rendering uses an Adaptive Frequency Net to predict per-point frequency and phase, enabling real-time, high-frequency detail reconstruction that is significantly faster than NeRF.
